summary: Jiuzi Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC as a foreign private issuer, disclosing its ordinary share count as of August 24, 2026. The filing attributes an increase in shares to prior transactions: warrant exercises, registered direct offerings, and S-8 issuances. No new special-situation event—such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic review—is announced. This is a routine update of issued share capital, not a classified special situation.
